stream: C - selection and content heterogeneity (E1b, E3c, E3d, R1-3, R1-5)

definitions.S1, S2: Sample 1 = Eedi task 1-2 files (t12), Sample 2 = task 3-4 files (t34), as in the submitted paper.
definitions.tagged answer: an answer with a confidence rating, Confidence non-missing and in [0, 100] (common.tagged).
definitions.reporter: a student with at least one tagged answer.
definitions.item p-value (p_all): proportion correct for the QuestionId over ALL answers in the sample.
definitions.item p-value (p_loo): leave-one-out version: proportion correct for the QuestionId over all OTHER answers in the sample (removes the answer's own correctness). Primary difficulty measure.
definitions.relative accuracy (rel): IsCorrect - p_loo per answer; mean = accuracy beyond what item difficulty predicts.
definitions.strand: level-1 subject of the question in subject_metadata.csv (Number, Algebra, Geometry and Measure, Data and Statistics, ...). A question listing several level-1 subjects gets the combined label (e.g. 'Number+Algebra') as its own category.
definitions.topic: level-2 subject of the question (69 level-2 subjects in the tree), combination rule as for strand.
definitions.term: approximate English school term from the calendar month of DateAnswered: Autumn Sep-Dec, Spring Jan-Mar, Summer Apr-Aug, within academic year. Approximation; actual term dates are not in the data.
definitions.difficulty strata: global answer-level quintiles of p_loo over all answers of the sample (edges in weighting.difficulty_strata_edges_p_loo); answers with undefined p_loo form a sixth stratum.
definitions.paired difference: per student: mean over tagged answers minus mean over untagged answers; summary over students (mean, median, SD, IQR, share > 0) with a student-bootstrap 95% CI of the mean (B = 1000).
definitions.basis all_untagged: students with >= 5 tagged and >= 5 untagged answers; all their untagged answers.
definitions.basis same_quiz: only answers in student x QuizId pairs that contain both tagged and untagged answers; students with >= 5 tagged and >= 5 untagged such answers. Isolates which answers a student rates when rating was evidently available in that quiz.
definitions.TVD: total variation distance between the student's strand (or topic) distribution on tagged vs untagged answers, 0 = identical, 1 = disjoint. The permutation baseline shuffles the tag labels within student once (same counts), so it is the TVD expected from sampling noise alone.
definitions.eta2: share of the variance of the 0/1 tag indicator that lies between groups (student, quiz, question, student x quiz, calendar month).
definitions.Design A: pool of students with >= 200 tagged answers (S1 1,389; S2 554); the same per-N subsamples as the submitted analysis (seed [42, 5, N, sid]).
definitions.reliability: Spearman-Brown corrected split-half correlation across students, averaged over 50 splits (temporal: 1 split), exactly as reliability.py.
definitions.minN70 / minN80: first crossing of r = .70 / .80 on the Design A grid, log-linear interpolation, as reliability.py; 'inf' = not reached by N = 200. CI = percentile over the 1000 joint bootstrap draws of the submitted analysis; an upper bound of null = some draws never cross.
definitions.minus_random: paired difference to the random-split curve of the same subsamples, per bootstrap draw (CI over draws where both curves cross).
definitions.w_diff: each tagged answer weighted by P_untagged(stratum) / P_tagged(stratum) within student, difficulty strata; weights renormalised to mean 1 per student. Students with < 20 untagged answers keep weight 1 (no reliable target). Indices are weighted means of the same responses.
definitions.w_diffstrand: as w_diff with strata = difficulty quintile x strand.
definitions.balanced: difficulty-balanced subset: the N responses are drawn without replacement with probability proportional to the w_diff weight (balanced_ds: w_diffstrand weight), then 50 random splits, unweighted indices. Equal-weight alternative to w_diff.
definitions.strand / topic / term split: half A = the first N//2 responses after ordering the student's categories at random (whole categories go to one half; only one category can straddle the cut); 50 random orders.
definitions.difficulty split: half A = the N//2 responses on the hardest items (lowest p_loo), half B = the rest; ties broken at random, 50 repetitions.
definitions.shared_category_response_share: share of a student's N responses whose category occurs in both halves; measures how content-disjoint the halves are (keyed vs random split).
definitions.restricted_largest_category_le_half: point estimates on the students whose largest category holds <= 50% of their N responses, so that the halves are clearly content-separated; random, keyed and temporal on the same students.
definitions.target_subset: point estimates on the Design A students that have a weighting target for both weight schemes (>= 20 untagged answers), raw vs weighted vs balanced on the same students.
definitions.fullset_bias_shift: bias on ALL of a student's tagged answers, raw vs difficulty-reweighted, for students with a weighting target; mean shift, Pearson r and top-decile Jaccard.
definitions.kish_ess_ratio: (sum w)^2 / sum w^2 / N per student: effective share of the N responses left after weighting.
definitions.w_null_diff / w_null_diffstrand: null weights: each student's own w_diff (w_diffstrand) weight vector permuted at random across that student's rated answers. Same weight distribution and Kish ESS, no link to difficulty or strand. The gap between a real-weight result and its null is the composition effect; the gap between the null and the raw result is the cost of unequal weights alone.
definitions.headline: flat copies of the most quotable numbers. Differences in accuracy / item p / shares are on the 0-1 scale (x 100 = percentage points); bias is on the 0-1 confidence scale. reporters_* = computed on the answers of reporters only (students with >= 1 rated answer). baseline_r20_gamma / _auroc = submitted Design A random-split values at N = 20 (AUROC under the submitted constant-confidence rule), read from results/baseline.

not_computed: Gamma and AUROC under structured splits and reweighting: not computed in this stream, because the AUROC constant-confidence rule is being changed in stream A, and both rank indices are below .30 at N = 20 under random splits in the submitted analysis (headline: baseline_r20_gamma, baseline_r20_auroc).

Selection on unobservables (for example, a student skipping the rating when unsure of the answer) cannot be separated from difficulty or content in these data: confidence on unrated answers is not observed.
Monitoring on untagged answers is unobservable; the reweighting assumes that, within a difficulty (x strand) stratum, a student's tagged answers stand for the untagged ones.
Whether a quiz offered the rating prompt to a student is not recorded; the same-quiz basis uses quiz attempts in which the student rated at least one answer as the evidence of availability.
Gender codes are reported raw; their labels are not verified (unknown).
Term split uses calendar-month approximations of English school terms; actual term dates are unknown.

part4_sample_descriptives.student_metadata_note: Gender is reported as raw codes; the code-to-label mapping is not verified here (unknown). DateOfBirth is month resolution.
